paper_read_scope: Author arxiv2603.08075v1 intro/relatedwork/method3.1-3.2.3/Algorithm1, experiments4.1-4.3/setup/metrics/ablations/hyperparameters/conclusion5 and textual appendicesA-C including explicit limitations. Not all figures visually or accepted-versus-arxiv exact equivalence.
paper_limitations_summary: Author appendixC.2 notes strong pretrained-backbone/GPU reliance and potential prototype/adaptation instability under very nonstationary or large-category streams. No proven reversible semantic recovery or our dense causal coverage.
state_memory: Own-predicted growing normalized Known/anonymous prototypes and batch adaptation, no member-level rollback/quarantine/versioned crossvideo token lineage.
evaluation: Top-query-class-count-sized clusters and separate/global Hungarian mapping; those GT cardinality/remapping conventions are not our fixedKnown full-denominator CT. Source test shuffle and non-strict checkpoint loading remain qualified.
paper_source_followup: Paper Eq17/18 has positive beta2 times sum(1-cos) under minimization, which by that literal sign favors similarity; actual trainer188-200 minimizes minus mean(1-cos), favoring separation. Formula sign/normalization distinction, not a measured upstream failure or silent correction.
Paper main test-time encoder lr1e-4 differs from actual trainer113-130 norm-parameter SGD0.1(CLIP)/0.01(DINO). Exact checkpoint/config binding not verified.
Main paper describes DINO ViT-B/16; appendixA.2 describes DINOv2ViTBase. Treat release/backbone provenance separately, no exact equivalence claim.
Paper estimated153 categories on200-classCUB illustrates underdiscovery as well as fragmentation reduction; not category-persistence or ID-invariance proof. Public tables are not our run results.

model_inputs: Images and own predicted assignments for TTA; offline Known labels only in inspected CUB training construction
model_outputs: Unit image features and incremental Known/anonymous prototype assignment
losses: Offline angular-margin CE plus supervised contrastive; TTA entropy minus own pseudo-cluster/prototype agreement and intercluster separation
training_protocol: CUB Known labelled subset only; NCM prototypes on Known training data; shuffled unlabelled evaluation called each epoch; Train-quantile helper computed but evaluation uses supplied self.tau
online_or_offline: Known-only offline fitting then batch-stream test-time encoder/prototype adaptation
causal_or_noncausal: Prediction path does not use label in inspected evaluate; features are encoded as whole batch, assignment is sequential, encoder/EMA update after batch. Not demonstrated dense event-causal TrackOCD; future-within-batch adaptation at chunk boundaries must not be relabelled event-level PASS
what_to_borrow: Train-calibrated Known cosine margins, bounded own-predicted support-weighted prototype updates as hypotheses; compare frozen/noTTA control
what_not_to_borrow: Evaluation-label Hungarian Known remapping, shuffled image protocol as causal video order, batch test adaptation or mutable Known prototypes without TrackOCD preregistration and safety proofs; no unlicensed source copying
